lookback_source.quote: The standard look-back period for the MDS 3.0 is 7 days, unless otherwise stated.

lookback_notes: The document states a standard look-back period of 7 days for the MDS 3.0 unless otherwise stated. The pages supplied do not state how the 7 days are counted relative to the Assessment Reference Date (e.g., "ARD plus the 6 prior days"); that counting detail is NOT_FOUND in this excerpt. The document also references items whose look-back period relates back to the Admission/Entry, Reentry, or Prior OBRA or scheduled PPS assessment, whichever is most recent, but does not express those as a number of days.

federal_coding_rules.rule: The standard look-back period for the MDS 3.0 is 7 days, unless otherwise stated.

federal_coding_rules.rule: With the exception of certain items (e.g., some items in Sections J, K and O), the look-back period does not extend into the preadmission period unless the item instructions state otherwise.

federal_coding_rules.rule: In the case of reentry, the look-back period does not extend into time prior to the reentry, unless instructions state otherwise.

source.quote: In the case of reentry, the look-back period does not extend into time prior to the reentry, unless instructions state otherwise.

federal_coding_rules.rule: When determining the response to items that have a look-back period relating back to the Admission/Entry, Reentry, or Prior OBRA or scheduled PPS assessment, whichever is most recent, staff must only consider those assessments that are required to be submitted to iQIES.

source.quote: When determining the response to items that have a look-back period relating back to the Admission/Entry, Reentry, or Prior OBRA or scheduled PPS assessment, whichever is most recent, staff must only consider those assessments that are required to be submitted to iQIES.

federal_coding_rules.rule: PPS assessments completed for private insurance and Medicare Advantage Plans must not be submitted to iQIES and therefore should not be considered when determining the "prior assessment."
